title: Grand Admiral Thrawn
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: When Governor Pryce pleaded with her Imperial superiors to provide her with a stronger force to solve her Rebel problem, the Empire answered with Grand Admiral Thrawn. Thrawn was a blue-skinned Chiss, whose striking appearance was only augmented by his glimmering red eyes. Thrawn was a master tactician and his love of executing a crushing game of cat and mouse was rivaled only by his affection for fine artwork.
